meta.title: Lpipe memory
meta.description: Manage wishes, settings and recollections for Lpipe. Does not archive conversations.

panel.title: Memory Pipeline
panel.scopeHint: Choose which lists to share. With sharing off, all lists are limited to the Lpipe main session. Subagents are always excluded.
panel.recollectionsHint: Each scene holds recollections and thoughts. Sharing a scene shares both.
panel.staleAfterDays: Days before a scene is marked not loaded for a long time
panel.invalidName: Use lowercase English words separated by hyphens, up to 32 characters.
panel.duplicateName: That name is already in use.
panel.nonemptyScene: Remove the recollections before deleting this scene.
panel.existingScenes: Remove scenes before lowering this limit.
panel.existingSceneEntries: The scene {scene} has too many recollections for this limit.
panel.existingSceneText: A recollection in {scene} exceeds this length.
panel.listScopeHint: Other top-level conversations can use this list when sharing is on. Turn it off to keep the list in the Lpipe main session.
panel.scopeOffHint: Turn on sharing above to share this list.
panel.wishesHint: Things you want to do, without deadlines or reminders.
panel.settingsHint: Information eligible conversations can use by default.
panel.disabled: Off · You can still manage entries
panel.loadFailed: Could not load memory. Try again.
panel.saveFailed: Could not confirm the save. Reload memory before making another change.
panel.addLimit: The list is full. Remove an entry first.
panel.entriesRange: Enter a whole number from 1 to {limit}.
panel.textRange: Enter a whole number from 1 to {limit}.
panel.existingEntries: Remove entries before lowering the limit this far.
panel.existingText: Shorten or remove entries that exceed the new character limit.
panel.reviewHint: Wake the main conversation for review at the scheduled time. If busy, wait until it is idle.
panel.existingThoughts: The scene {scene} has too many thoughts for this limit.
